open.subject: Ground floor open zone — the pool's curved intrusion
open.question: how much of the pool's circular segment falls inside the SALON: the whole of it, or half?
open.why_it_matters: the take-off deducts half (1.2448 m2) and the benchmark behaves as though the whole segment (2.4897 m2) were deducted. That one fraction accounts for 1.2448 of the 1.2867 m2 gap and leaves 0.0418 m2, which is 137.5418 rounded to 137.5
open.what_would_settle_it: the drawing at the pool edge, or the scope note that says which face the SALON is measured to there
open.do_not: no fraction is adopted to close the gap. engine.finishes_rules refuses a curved intrusion whose applicable fraction is not established
